text.p: Three Months Ended Six Months Ended
(in thousands, except share and per share data)
NOTE: Boyds Wheels Inc said its net loss for the second quarter and first six months of 1997 included a one-time charge of approximately $1.8 million.

The one-time charges recorded in the second quarter of 1997 includes a sales reserve of $1,000,000 which consists mainly of a $700,000 reserve for motorcycle products; a cost of sales charge of $700,000, which consists of approximately $200,000 from the sale of scrap, $300,000 resulting from a change in accounting estimate for the depreciation of molds, and $200,000 in the write-off of leasehold improvements associated with units to be subleased and selling general and administrative expenses of $100,000 relating to the planned sale of underutilized equipment.
